lines.t: (Verse 1)
When the quiet night is falling,
And the world begins to rest,
I lift my heart toward heaven,
For Your love is always best.
Through every thought and moment,
No matter what I do,
My mind keeps turning gently,
Back again to You.
(Pre-Chorus)
All my thoughts dwell on You,
My God, My Savior.
(Chorus)
I can't take my mind off You,
As I think of You I feel You near.
(Chorus)
I can't take my mind off You,
As I think of You I feel You near.
I can't take my mind off You,
YahuShua, You are so dear,
To me.
Your stuck inside my head.
I think of You as I lay upon my bed.
Each morning when I wake up,
Your the one I think of first.
YahuShua, all my thoughts are on You.
(Verse 2)
When the morning light is rising,
And a brand-new day begins,
I just breathe Your name,
And feel Your peace within.
My troubles float away,
My soul feels at ease.
And I will always strive
To please, You...
(Bridge)
You're the song within my heart,
Even when the night is long,
Your love won't let me part.
Lord, my heart will forever belong to You
(Final Chorus)
I can't take my mind off You,
As I think of You I feel You near.
I can't take my mind off You,
YahuShua, You are so dear,
To me.
Your stuck inside my head.
I think of You as I lay upon my bed.
Each morning when I wake up,
Your the one I think of first.
YahuShua, all my thoughts are on You.
